head: fb8d2f71b836266df07bf1b658e40c0aa13804f3
observations: Test-only collector requires both child exit and stdout EOF before completion.
One five-second startup watchdog becomes one absolute two-second finish watchdog after the first observed byte; later bytes cannot renew it.
Each completion rechecks its deadline; final status after timeout remains diagnostic.
Nonblocking reads have an explicit 128-byte limit; errors and invalid UTF-8 cannot satisfy output assertions.
Original child guard retains kill/reap ownership; the collector starts no reader thread.
Controller cancellation releases its channel before joining; the nonblocking three-byte write is bounded.
Exact OLD/NEW script bytes, mode 0755, regular-file check, successful exit and complete expected output remain asserted.
The changed observation boundary is explicit in the code and documentation; this is not a product deadline change.
limits: No independent historical cause attribution or full failed-suite clearance.
This read is exact fb8, not a latest-821 carry/native gate.
No device, physical power-loss or signature-trust qualification.
